cases.description: Interrupted bound briefing claims remain readable by the previous native journal reader
cases.setup: Queue an addressed synthetic briefing and persist real prepared, uncertain, and accepted-before-cleanup states in private homes. Use fake transport and separate baseline and candidate test processes.
cases.action: Drain a workspace tick and protected Relay using the baseline, then repeat with the candidate while its confirmed successor window is pending and after it expires. Compare the original intent, pinned claim and exact receipt across recovery boundaries.
cases.expected: No briefing is submitted again. Prepared becomes uncertain, uncertain keeps the original batch, and accepted closes only after persisting the exact independent-proof receipt. The ordinary tick and protected Relay stay queued through the new bounded input opportunity and resume separately from the briefing after expiry. No keys are sent.
